name: @markwhen/oneview
description: Lean Imba canvas recreation of the visible OneView timeline.

scripts.build: imba build src/main.imba --web -o dist -p --bundle --minify && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),m=require('./dist/manifest.json');fs.writeFileSync('dist/index.html','<html><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width,initial-scale=1\"><title>Calendar</title></head><body><script type=\"module\" src=\"/'+m.main+'\"></script></body></html>');"
scripts.lines: find src tests -type f \( -name '*.imba' -o -name '*.js' \) -print0 | xargs -0 wc -l
